svg.title: Step 7 mockup 23: Scoring at the desk: screenshot, who played, tap to place, awards preview, save
svg.text: 23 · Scoring at the desk: screenshot, who played, tap to place, awards preview, save
Use case: the crew scores a session fast and enjoys it. A screenshot helps, three sources show who played, a tap places, the preview shows the effect, saving is a reveal. Demo names only.
3 · Tap to place, name the teams
Drop a file, paste, or take a photo on the crew phone
Read it with the AI reader
The picture goes to the provider set for the event.
It finds names, placements and game stats.
A person checks everything. Nothing counts yet.
Players cannot add a screen: a wrong or faked picture
would move the standings. The crew sees every picture.
The reader is off until the organiser turns it on, with
its consent notice (pizza’s receipt reader pattern, #644).
Read: 4 names, 4 places, kills per player.
Reg = registered · Voice = in the room · Shot = on the screenshot
Voice alone never decides. Nothing is final until Save.
Tap a team or player: 1st, then 2nd…
The crew names the teams, for example to fit the game.
Team names show on the match, the reveal and the results.
They never enter the season standings.
“N0VA_x” is now Nova for Demo Arena.
The next screenshot matches by itself.
Best play · Kestrel · +1 · note: the clutch
The hall screen shows the winners, then the awards,
then the standings sliding. See sheet 24.
A later change is a correction with a reason (D7).
Nothing counts until the crew saves. The reader and the sources only fill the form in.
In-game names are remembered per person and game: the platform stores the name the crew linked, so the next screenshot matches alone.
